qualityGate.reason: The Playwright tests are compilable and use Playwright APIs correctly, preserving testCaseId in titles. However, selectors like text=Electronics and .product-item may be fragile without more specific attributes or roles. Assertions on page title are somewhat weak to fully guarantee correct page load. The third test lacks proper validation to confirm products belong to the selected category beyond counting visible elements. Additional test data handling and strong assertions are recommended for robustness.
